entities.name: Lambholt
entities.description: Farming village in Kessig on Innistrad, known for livestock and its struggle against werewolf attacks.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: Forest at the edge of which Lambholt's pasture was carved.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel whose disappearance weakened protective wards.

entities.name: Old Stickfingers
entities.description: Horror that terrorized Lambholt until driven off.

entities.name: Vadrik
entities.description: Astronomer mage who helped drive off Old Stickfingers.

entities.name: Rem Karolus
entities.description: Inquisitor who helped drive off Old Stickfingers.

entities.name: Werewolves
entities.description: Creatures that frequently attack the village's livestock and people.

events.summary: After Avacyn's disappearance the harvest festival evolves into a hunters' contest in the Ulvenwald.
events.quote: the festival evolved into a hunters' contest

events.summary: Old Stickfingers is driven off with the help of Vadrik and Rem Karolus.
events.quote: until it was driven off with the help of the astronomer mage Vadrik and inquisitor Rem Karolus
